faq.q: What is the origin of Ismet?
faq.a: Ismet is associated with Arabic. Ismet is the Turkish form of Arabic عِصْمَة (ʿIṣma), meaning 'protection, chastity'.
Yes — the underlying form عِصْمَت is Arabic.
